🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 22, 2026

Venus, in detriment in Scorpio, holds a square to Pluto, in Aquarius. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Across from you in Libra, Sun holds the other half of the account. Cardinal fire meets a bill. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. From Pisces, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed earth keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Pisces, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Pisces, untitled. Venus in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you, fallen in Libra. Venus squares you from Scorpio: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fixed fire: the grip is the expense. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Scorpio, the sign that suits it least. Sun is with you, close enough to read the small print. Cardinal air: beginning and paying are one act. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Fixed water: the holding and the held stop differing. Mars has not been in Cancer for four weeks.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Venus in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Scorpio, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Fixed air: the grip costs more than the thing. The hold Sun had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Venus in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.
